profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record is tagged with the operator name CenturyLink, the legacy brand of the telecommunications company now operating as Lumen Technologies, which formally renamed itself in September 2020. Its coordinates fall in rural Caldwell County, Missouri, near Hamilton, a small town roughly an hour northeast of Kansas City, well outside the coverage area of the colocation-focused aggregator directories this registry typically relies on for facility-level detail; none of those directories, nor a Wikipedia article on Hamilton, Missouri, mention any telecommunications facility at this location. Rather than assume this is a genuine colocation data center comparable to CenturyLink/Lumen's larger metro facilities, this entry treats it as most likely a small legacy telephone central-office or exchange building, a common category of "data_center"-tagged OpenStreetMap point that reflects historical ILEC (incumbent local exchange carrier) infrastructure rather than a modern, multi-tenant colocation facility; CenturyLink's corporate lineage runs through US West, Qwest, Embarq, and other legacy telecom mergers that collectively built out a large rural exchange network across the central United States long before the company adopted the Lumen name. No address, square footage, or capacity figure can be honestly asserted for a building of this uncertain type and no located source, so this entry is deliberately left short of confirmed facility-level detail. Missouri is one of the 20 states included in Lumens 2022 divestiture of its legacy CenturyLink local telephone operations to Brightspeed, a new company formed by investment firm Apollo Global Management for 7.5 billion dollars plus 1.4 billion dollars in assumed debt in a deal that closed October 3, 2022. If this rural exchange building remains an active telecom facility, it most likely now operates under the Brightspeed name rather than CenturyLink, though this registry has not found a source confirming that transfer for this specific building and does not assert it.
